name: Aakash T C S
headline: Generative AI Engineer
tagline: I build agentic AI systems, RAG pipelines and LLM automations that take the busywork off people's plates, so they can focus on what matters.
availability: AI Engineer at Movate · building agentic AI
about: I'm an AI Engineer at Movate, where I design multi-agent LangGraph workflows, RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, and LLM integrations for enterprise clients such as Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise and Nokia.

My work runs from prompt and retrieval design to production Python services: tool-calling agents over MCP, streaming responses over SSE, and the guardrails, logging and session isolation that keep them dependable. I'm always asking how AI can make someone's day a little easier.

stats.label: Production users on my agent chatbot

experience.summary: Enterprise generative AI for clients including Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise and Nokia.
points: Designed and refined prompts and RAG workflows for enterprise LLM applications, using contextual enrichment to ground responses.
Built modular LangChain/LangGraph workflows with conditional routing, tool invocation and conversation state for multi-step tasks.
Integrated Azure OpenAI, Gemini/Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock (Claude) and Groq with Python services and REST APIs.
Implemented Flask/REST integrations and SSE streaming for conversational responses, with grounding metadata and model safety settings.
Developed reusable Python modules for Dialogflow intent-creation automation, web scraping and data preprocessing.
Contributed to prototypes in agentic AI, RAG-to-DAX automation, customer-support analysis, fraud analysis and semi-agentic chatbots.

projects.title: Agent-Native Conversational Chatbot
projects.imageAlt: Architecture: a customer message goes to a LangGraph orchestrator, which uses a Neo4j GraphRAG intent map to route it to support, knowledge or ticketing agents; the ticketing agent calls a Salesforce MCP tool to raise a ticket.
projects.summary: An agent-native support chatbot that orchestrates specialised agents over a knowledge graph and live Salesforce tools.
highlights: LangGraph orchestrator routes user intents to specialised support agents.
Neo4j knowledge graph with Cypher-based GraphRAG maps each query to the right agent.
Salesforce APIs exposed as MCP tools so a ReAct agent can raise support tickets on request.
Logging, safety guardrails, checkpointed conversation history and per-user session isolation.
projects.impact: Used regularly by 200+ users in production

projects.title: AI Document Extraction & Analytics View
projects.imageAlt: Architecture: business documents pass through a private LLM gateway into MySQL; an engineer's question goes through a LangGraph router to a SQL agent that queries MySQL and returns an answer and an analytics view.
projects.summary: Turns unstructured business documents into queryable data, with a chatbot and an analytics view on top.
highlights: LLM workflows extract and structure information from business documents into MySQL.
LangGraph routes natural-language chatbot and analytics questions to a SQL-based agent.
Integrated an enterprise private LLM gateway for document understanding and extraction.
Structured outputs feed downstream reporting, analytics and information retrieval.
projects.impact: Used by network engineers for technical queries and analytics

projects.title: Natural Language to Pandas Analytics
projects.imageAlt: A plain-English question becomes generated pandas code, which passes syntax, logic and generated test-case checks with bounded retries before returning a results table.
projects.summary: Ask a business dataset a question in plain English and get validated pandas code and the answer back.
highlights: Turns questions plus DataFrame schemas into pandas filtering logic.
Syntax and logic checks, generated test cases and bounded retries catch bad code before it runs.
projects.impact: Catches invalid or incorrect generated code before it runs

projects.title: Grounded Q&A with Vertex AI Vector Search
projects.imageAlt: A question is embedded with BGE, matched against a Vertex AI Vector Search index, and the top retrieved passages ground a Gemini answer with citations.
projects.summary: Semantic retrieval over a Vertex AI Vector Search index, grounding Gemini answers in retrieved sources.
highlights: Index and endpoint built on BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings.
Retrieved context feeds Gemini, with attention to grounding, retrieval quality and safety settings.
